title: P1 Outage Action Playbook
chunks: We had a P1 outage for 40 minutes. Containment: acknowledge incident, assemble an incident commander, and open comms within five minutes.
Action plan: restore the affected service, keep stakeholders updated every 15 minutes, and create follow-up tasks with owners and ETAs.
Post-incident: run an RCA within 72 hours, document the timeline, and track mitigations to closure.

title: Reliability Guidelines
chunks: Incident severity P1 means critical user impact and requires immediate response.
Communication: publish status updates on the public channel every 15 minutes until resolution.
Stabilization: roll back risky changes, add guards, and increase observability if signals are missing.
Recovery: prioritize user-facing fixes before background tasks, and confirm with live checks.

title: Mission Operations Checklist
chunks: For any critical outage, identify blast radius, appoint roles (IC, Comms, Scribe), and start a live bridge.
Capture the exact start time, duration, user impact, and the hypothesis for the root cause.
Action items must include owner, ETA, and verification steps; track them to completion and share learnings.
